scan: cw0325000a.jp2 (LOC 99447491, sheet 1, First day), full-resolution px; the roads-task field is on the 50% render: px50 = scan/2
model: ground EN -> px50 = base affine + bilinear displacement field (450 px grid) [docs/basemap1863/features/roads-rail-water/registration_sheet_a.json]; scan->EN by Newton inversion (tools/bt/troopmaps/fieldmodel_a.py)

caveats: Sheet-a constraints are dense along the Chambersburg, Mummasburg, Hagerstown, Carlisle, Harrisburg, Hanover, Baltimore, Taneytown and Emmitsburg roads and sparse in the far north-west, the south-west and the east beyond Rock Creek; outside the constrained band the displacement field decays to zero and the error is larger than the stated figures.
The hand-read road lines assume the modern TIGER centreline lies on the 1863 road line (a modern realignment would be absorbed into the registration).
The numbers are leave-one-out values on 23 Warren GCPs and 26 hand-read stations, not an independent ground survey.

committed_chain_for_comparison: docs/basemap1863/maps/transforms/bachelder-1876-sheet1.json (TPS to Warren px + Warren affine): the same hand-read buildings are 70-138 m out in the north-west with the chain

independent_validation.points_used: single-building reads McLean barn, McLean house, Pennsylvania Hall; ambiguous identifications (Schmucker Hall, Black Horse Tavern) are excluded and listed
independent_validation.cluster_level_checks: McPherson, Shultz and McMillan symbol clusters, Thompson house area: the county building outlines drawn through the field model fall inside the printed symbol clusters, 10-25 px (about 10-25 m) from the cluster centres (tmp view vecover.py af; not tabulated as numbers)

honest_bound: 1-sigma about 30 m over Seminary Ridge / McPherson Ridge / Oak Ridge south of McLean farm / the town and east to Rock Creek. Beyond it (Herr Ridge and the far west, the north beyond McLean farm, east of Rock Creek) not quantified: use 50 m.
